name: Baccharis trimera oil
description: Baccharis trimera oil (CAS 68916-07-4 ), also traded under the botanical reference Oils, Baccharis genistelloides, is a plant-derived essential oil cold-pressed or extracted from the Baccharis trimera shrub, native to South America. It is sourced for its antioxidant and moisturizing activity in finished formulations across personal care and pharmaceutical applications. In cosmetic formulations, the oil is incorporated into creams, serums, and body lotions. It contributes moisturizing and skin-conditioning performance in these applications. Antioxidant-active botanical oils like this are also used in topical pharmaceutical preparations to support formulation stability and active ingredient protection. Hair care product developers use plant-based oils of this profile as functional components in conditioners and scalp treatments. Its botanical origin and functional profile also position it for use in natural and organic-certified lines. This material is ideal for personal care lines where clean-label sourcing is a procurement requirement. Baccharis trimera oil is supplied as a liquid oil, typically in bulk quantities suited for industrial formulation. It is generally available in cosmetic or technical grade, with documentation supporting personal care and topical pharmaceutical use.
